args.summary:
Built a 2D spine-beam model of a four-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete single-cell box girder bridge (35+45+45+35 m, deck 12.5 m wide) continuous on piers, per JTG D60-2015 / JTG 3362-2018.

Key modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, system continuous_on_piers (twin circular pier columns modelled, bases fixed).
- Girder: cast_box section (h=2.2 m, B_top=12.5, B_bot=6.5, t_top=0.25, t_bot=0.22, t_web=0.45), A=6.712 m², I=4.4982 m⁴, Ec=34500 MPa (C50), γ=26 kN/m³, w=174.512 kN/m, m=17.789 t/m (girder self-weight only).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge=1.2 MPa manufacturer override via MR-00): Abutments 0 & 4 PTFE sliding (400×500, 5×11 mm, 2 per line, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0); Piers 1 & 3 PTFE sliding (550×650, 6×11 mm, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0); Pier 2 plain elastomeric fixed (600×700, 7×11 mm, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13091 kN/m). Rotations free; sliding bearings longitudinal free.
- Piers: twin 1.8 m columns merged to single column, A=5.089 m², I=1.0306 m⁴, Ec=32500 MPa (C40); lengths 26, 10, 29 m for Piers 1, 2, 3.
- Live load: Class I, 3 lanes (carriageway 11.5 m), qk=10.5 kN/m, xi=0.78, Pk=330/350/350/330 kN per span, impact factor μ=0.1572 from f1=2.660 Hz.

Results: first three vertical frequencies 2.660, 3.612, 4.787 Hz. Self-weight support reactions ≈ 2266/7701/7988/7699/2267 kN; max lane positive moment 11539 kN·m, max negative support moment −9597 kN·m. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
